g.title: HR_COURSEPREREQUIREMENTS
g.text: Course Prerequirements - Contains the course prerequirements.
The identifier of the Course record.
Indicates the type of course prerequirement.
Indicates the skill requested as prerequirement of the course.
Indicates the study requested as prerequirement of the course.
Indicates the course requested as prerequirement of the course.
Indicates the job requested as prerequirement of the course.
Indicates comment for the course prerequirement.
Indicates the ranking of the course prerequirement.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_COURSE
g.text: Course - This entity contains the catalogue of courses.
The identifier of course type record.
This field enables an additional classification of the Training Type; beyond Classroom, VCR, E-Learning.
The identifier of course category record.
A description of the course and its objectives.
The identifier of visual resource for the banner.
The identifier of self enrolment policy record.
The page of displayed to the learners.
When a company is associated to a course it means that any HR with a Security Filter defined on a different company will not be able to view or manage this course and all related sessions.
Use this field to define the survey to be sent to learners to gather feedback after the course.
Use this field to define the survey to be sent to instructors after the course to gather feedback.
Indicates if attendees can rate this course.
Indicates if social wall is enabled for enrolled people.
The template to be used for the attendance certificate.
Specifies the teaching method for the course.
The identifier of lablur cost option record.
Specify a filter of people for whom this course is designed.
Specify a filter to identify the most suitable instructor.
The identifier of the training centre record.
The identifier of the classroom record.
The identifier of the organizational unit record.
The questionnaire that will be used to assess the effectiveness of the Participant Training.
Activate this flag to mark this Training resource as required for compulsory training. For example, to renew or take a certification/qualification.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
